modelClaim.sourceTextOriginal: Good morning, everyone, and happy Tuesday 😉 Now that Monday is gone, we can enjoy life 😁 Here is another Kling 4.0 video. You can find the prompt below, as usual https://t.co/IDMfuQQtCO

originalPrompt: Ultra-realistic cinematic close-up of an elegant female android awakening inside a sterile futuristic laboratory, intricate chrome machinery unfolding around her skull like mechanical petals, dozens of articulated robotic arms reconnecting cables and neural interfaces, tiny red status lights pulsing beneath translucent skin, her glowing crimson eyes slowly focusing on the camera, subtle breathing motion, micro facial expressions, hydraulic pistons moving naturally, camera slowly dollies forward while orbiting around her face, shallow depth of field, realistic reflections on polished metal, volumetric laboratory haze, physically accurate motion, seamless mechanical animation, high-end sci-fi film realism 😉
